result.instructions: Tools for Samita, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which wholesale pricing rules are active in my store?"; "Show the volume pricing tiers for rule 1234."; "Which of my B2B price rules are drafts?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Samita data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run samita_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run samita_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run samita_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. samita_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: samita_list_wholesale_pricings
tools.title: List wholesale pricing rules
tools.description: List wholesale pricing rules (B2B price rules) of the store, with title, status and the customers and products each rule applies to. Samita's endpoint docs allow about 1 request per 5 minutes per store, so do not call this in a loop. Samita API: GET /wholesale-pricings.

query.description: Search text matched against the title or the record ID.

status.description: Only records with this status. Leave empty for all.

sort.description: Sort by creation time. 'descrease' is newest first (the vendor's spelling). Default: newest first.

tools.name: samita_get_wholesale_pricing
tools.title: Get a wholesale pricing rule
tools.description: Get one wholesale pricing rule by id, with its customer and product rules and discount groups. Samita's endpoint docs allow about 1 request per 5 minutes per store, so do not call this in a loop. Samita API: GET /wholesale-pricings/{id}.

tools.name: samita_list_volume_pricings
tools.title: List volume pricing rules
tools.description: List volume pricing rules (quantity or amount discount tiers) of the store, with title, status, type and the products each rule applies to. Samita's endpoint docs allow about 1 request per 5 minutes per store, so do not call this in a loop. Samita API: GET /volume-pricings.

query.description: Search text matched against the title or the record ID.

status.description: Only records with this status. Leave empty for all.

sort.description: Sort by creation time. 'descrease' is newest first (the vendor's spelling). Default: newest first.

tools.name: samita_get_volume_pricing
tools.title: Get a volume pricing rule
tools.description: Get one volume pricing rule by id, with its type (quantity or amount), product rules and tier ranges. Samita's endpoint docs allow about 1 request per 5 minutes per store, so do not call this in a loop. Samita API: GET /volume-pricings/{id}.
